passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Say to the Israelites, ‘When any man has a bodily discharge, the discharge is unclean.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
The LORD gave them instructions.
The LORD told them to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, "Tell the Israelites this message."
If any man has a bodily discharge, he is unclean.
The discharge makes him unclean.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִבְּשָׂר֔וֹ זוֹב֖וֹ טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃

passages.text: This uncleanness is from his discharge, whether his body allows the discharge to flow or blocks it. So his discharge will bring about uncleanness.
passages.sermon:
A man may have a bodily discharge.
This discharge makes him unclean.
His body may let the discharge flow.
Or his body may block the discharge.
In both cases, the discharge causes uncleanness.
passages.original: וְזֹ֛את תִּהְיֶ֥ה טֻמְאָת֖וֹ בְּזוֹב֑וֹ רָ֣ר בְּשָׂר֞וֹ אֶת־ זוֹב֗וֹ אֽוֹ־ הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ טֻמְאָת֖וֹ הִֽוא׃

passages.text: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies will be unclean, and any furniture on which he sits will be unclean.
passages.sermon:
A man has a bodily discharge.
This man is called unclean.
Any bed he lies on becomes unclean.
Any furniture he sits on becomes unclean.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א וְכָֽל־ הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃

passages.text: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A man has a discharge from his body.
This discharge makes him unclean.
Anyone who touches the bed of this man becomes unclean.
That person must wash his clothes.
That person must bathe in water.
That person will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּמִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Whoever sits on furniture on which the man with the discharge was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A man with a discharge is unclean.
He makes furniture unclean when he sits on it.
If anyone sits on that same furniture, he becomes unclean.
That person must wash his clothes.
He must bathe in water.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל־ הַכְּלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Whoever touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A man with a discharge is unclean.
Anyone who touches the body of this man must act.
He must wash his clothes.
He must bathe in water.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְהַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּבְשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: If the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A man has a bodily discharge.
This man is called "the man with the discharge."
If the man with the discharge spits on a person who is clean, that person becomes unclean.
The person who was spat on must wash his clothes.
He must also bathe in water.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכִֽי־ יָרֹ֛ק הַזָּ֖ב בַּטָּה֑וֹר וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Any saddle on which the man with the discharge rides will be unclean.
passages.sermon: A man with a discharge is unclean.\r\nIf he rides on a saddle, that saddle becomes unclean.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא׃

passages.text: Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and whoever carries such things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A man with a discharge is unclean.
Anything that was under him becomes unclean.
Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening.
Whoever carries those things must wash his clothes.
He must also bathe with water.
He will be unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: If the man with the discharge touches anyone without first rinsing his hands with water, the one who was touched must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A man has a bodily discharge.
This man is called "the man with the discharge."
If this man touches another person before washing his hands with water, that person becomes unclean.
The person who was touched must wash his clothes.
He must also bathe himself in water.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע־ בּוֹ֙ הַזָּ֔ב וְיָדָ֖יו לֹא־ שָׁטַ֣ף בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Any clay pot that the man with the discharge touches must be broken, and any wooden utensil must be rinsed with water.
passages.sermon:
A man with a discharge is called "the man with the discharge."  
If the man with the discharge touches a clay pot, you must break the clay pot.  
If the man with the discharge touches a wooden utensil, you must rinse the wooden utensil with water.
passages.original: וּכְלִי־ חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּע־ בּ֥וֹ הַזָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: When the man has been cleansed from his discharge, he must count off seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe himself in fresh water, and he shall be clean.
passages.sermon:
A man may have a bodily discharge.
This discharge makes him unclean.
When the man is healed from his discharge, he must do certain things.
He must count seven days for his cleansing.
He must wash his clothes.
He must bathe his body in fresh water.
After this, he will be clean.
passages.original: וְכִֽי־ יִטְהַ֤ר הַזָּב֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ וְסָ֨פַר ל֜וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בְּמַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְטָהֵֽר׃

passages.text: On the eighth day he is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, come before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.
passages.sermon:
A man who had a discharge must become clean.
He must wait seven days after his discharge ends.
On the eighth day, he must take two turtledoves or two young pigeons.
He must go to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
He must come before the LORD.
He must give the birds to the priest.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח־ לוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּבָ֣א׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: The priest is to sacrifice them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man before the LORD because of his discharge.
passages.sermon:
A priest receives two birds from the man who had a discharge.
The priest sacrifices the first bird as a sin offering.
The priest sacrifices the second bird as a burnt offering.
The priest makes atonement for the man before the LORD.
The atonement is for the man’s discharge.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon: A man may have an emission of semen.\r\nHe must wash his whole body with water.\r\nHe will be unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־ תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Any clothing or leather on which there is an emission of semen must be washed with water, and it will remain unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
This law speaks about clothing or leather.
If semen touches any clothing or leather, it becomes unclean.
You must wash the clothing or leather with water.
After washing, the item is still unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכָל־ בֶּ֣גֶד וְכָל־ ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖יו שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃פ

passages.text: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will remain unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A man and a woman may have sexual relations.
Semen may be released during this act.
Both the man and the woman must wash themselves with water.
They will be unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: When a woman has a discharge consisting of blood from her body, she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A woman may have a discharge of blood from her body.
This discharge is her menstruation.
She will be unclean for seven days during her menstruation.
Anyone who touches her during this time will be unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְאִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי־ תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖הּ בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Anything on which she lies or sits during her menstruation will be unclean, and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A woman who has her menstrual period is unclean for seven days.
Anything she lies on during her menstruation becomes unclean.
Anything she sits on during her menstruation becomes unclean.
Anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes.
He must also bathe with water.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃ וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Whoever touches any furniture on which she was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A woman who has a discharge of blood is unclean during her menstruation.
If anyone touches any furniture on which she sat, he becomes unclean.
He must wash his clothes.
He must bathe in water.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכָל־ כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑יו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: And whether it is a bed or furniture on which she was sitting, whoever touches it will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A woman may sit on a bed or on furniture during her menstruation.
If anyone touches that bed, he will become unclean.
If anyone touches that furniture, he will become unclean.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל־ הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־ עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעוֹ־ ב֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: If a man lies with her and her menstrual flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies will become unclean.
passages.sermon:
A man may lie with a woman during her menstrual period.
If her menstrual flow touches him, he becomes unclean.
He will be unclean for seven days.
Any bed on which he lies will also become unclean.
passages.original: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכָל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃פ

passages.text: When a woman has a discharge of her blood for many days at a time other than her menstrual period, or if it continues beyond her period, she will be unclean all the days of her unclean discharge, just as she is during the days of her menstruation.
passages.sermon:
A woman may have a discharge of blood.
This discharge may last for many days.
It may happen at a time that is not her regular menstrual period.
Or the discharge may continue beyond her normal period.
During all the days of this discharge, she is unclean.
She is unclean in the same way as during her menstrual period.
passages.original: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי־ יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת־ נִדָּתָ֔הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי־ תָז֖וּב עַל־ נִדָּתָ֑הּ כָּל־ יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא׃

passages.text: Any bed on which she lies or any furniture on which she sits during the days of her discharge will be unclean, like her bed during her menstrual period.
passages.sermon:
A woman may have a discharge of blood for many days.
This discharge is not part of her regular menstrual period.
During all the days of her discharge, she is unclean.
Any bed she lies on during these days will be unclean.
This bed is unclean in the same way as her bed during her menstrual period.
Any furniture she sits on during these days will also be unclean.
This furniture is unclean in the same way as during her menstrual period.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָיו֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔הּ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֑הּ וְכָֽל־ הַכְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔יו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Anyone who touches these things will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
Anyone who touches these things becomes unclean.
He must wash his clothes.
He must bathe in water.
He will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַנּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: When a woman is cleansed of her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.
passages.sermon:
A woman may have a discharge that makes her unclean.
When her discharge stops, she becomes cleansed from it.
She must count seven days after her discharge ends.
After these seven days, she becomes ceremonially clean.
passages.original: וְאִֽם־ טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזּוֹבָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃

passages.text: On the eighth day she is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
A woman who has been cleansed from her discharge must follow this law.
On the eighth day, she must take two turtledoves or two young pigeons.
She must bring these birds to the priest.
She must go to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
She must give the birds to the priest there.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח־ לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: The priest is to sacrifice one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge.
passages.sermon:
A priest serves the people of Israel.
A woman has become unclean because of a discharge.
The priest takes two birds from her.
He sacrifices one bird as a sin offering.
He sacrifices the other bird as a burnt offering.
The priest does this before the LORD.
The priest makes atonement for the woman.
He does this because of her unclean discharge.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִזּ֖וֹב טֻמְאָתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: You must keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die by defiling My tabernacle, which is among them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command for the Israelites.
The Israelites are God's chosen people.
God's tabernacle is among the Israelites.
God told Moses to warn the Israelites.
The Israelites must stay away from uncleanness.
If the Israelites become unclean, they must not defile God's tabernacle.
If the Israelites defile the tabernacle with their uncleanness, they will die.
passages.original: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֙תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת־ מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

passages.text: This is the law of him who has a discharge, of the man who has an emission of semen whereby he is unclean, of a woman in her menstrual period, of any male or female who has a discharge, and of a man who lies with an unclean woman.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel about uncleanness.
These laws concern people with bodily discharges.
A man with a discharge is unclean.
A man who has an emission of semen is unclean.
A woman during her menstrual period is unclean.
A man or a woman with any discharge is unclean.
A man who lies with an unclean woman becomes unclean.
passages.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַזָּ֑ב וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־ זֶ֖רַע לְטָמְאָה־ בָֽהּ׃ וְהַדָּוָה֙ בְּנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְהַזָּב֙ אֶת־ זוֹב֔וֹ לַזָּכָ֖ר וְלַנְּקֵבָ֑ה וּלְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם־ טְמֵאָֽה׃פ
